description: Public keys trusted to sign studiobrain-templates' _plugins.index.json (SBAI-7183). This is a DISTINCT trust domain from core's plugin-trusted-keys.json (SBAI-4630, per-plugin first_party/trusted_vendor/partner signatures) -- this registry only proves 'this index was produced by trusted CI', not 'this specific plugin was vetted by Biloxi'. Private keys never appear here; see scripts/sign_index.py.

keys.comment: Signs dist/_plugins.index.json in the push-to-main publish job only. Private seed lives in the templates repo's PLUGIN_INDEX_SIGNING_KEY GitHub Actions secret and Vaultwarden, never in git.
